verdict.rationale: SumUp documents a public API that can be driven programmatically. It covers checkout creation, refunds (full and partial) and HTTPS-driven Cloud API terminal payments, authenticated with API keys and wrapped by an official TypeScript SDK. Sandbox accounts support testing, and a community developer independently built an integration on the public API. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, and webhooks only report checkout status changes.
